name: Muslim Green Book
subtitle: Halal places, prayer & Qibla
promotionalText: Visiting Atlanta for the big games this summer? Find halal food, mosques, prayer spaces, and the Qibla direction — in English, Arabic, and Spanish.
description:
Muslim Green Book is your guide to Muslim-friendly places across metro Atlanta — built for residents and for visitors arriving for the matches and events this summer.

Find halal restaurants, mosques, markets, family attractions and more on a beautiful interactive map, then get directions, hours, and contact details in one tap. Filter by what matters to you: halal, alcohol-free, prayer space, and family-friendly.

FEATURES

• Interactive map & list — browse 80+ verified and community-listed places around Atlanta, each with photos, address, and category.
• Honest halal labeling — every place is clearly marked as halal-verified or community-listed, so you always know what's confirmed.
• Prayer times & Qibla — accurate daily prayer times for your location plus a Qibla compass, computed on-device.
• Powerful filters — narrow results to halal, alcohol-free, prayer space, or family-friendly in a tap.
• Save your favorites — keep a personal list of the places you want to visit.
• Three languages — full English, Arabic (with right-to-left layout), and Spanish.

No account required. Your location stays on your device and is only used to show nearby places, prayer times, and the Qibla direction.

Whether you live in Atlanta or you're visiting this summer, Muslim Green Book helps you eat well, pray on time, and feel at home.
whatsNew: Initial release. Discover halal places, mosques, prayer times, and the Qibla direction across metro Atlanta — in English, Arabic, and Spanish.
reviewNotes: This app has no Home Screen (WidgetKit) widget; we believe the 2.1(a) reference to "widgets" means the on-screen controls on the main Map/List screen. Root cause, now fixed in this build (1.0, build 10): the main screen loaded place data from our backend, so a brief network/backend interruption during review could show a "couldn't load" message instead of the controls. This build bundles offline data for all places, so the map, list, search field, filter chips, and the Map/List toggle always render and respond, even in Airplane Mode. The app is also a native universal app that runs on iPhone and iPad. To verify the controls: launch the app, tap the Map/List toggle at the top, tap any filter chip (Halal, Alcohol-free, Prayer space, Family-friendly), and type in the search box. All controls respond immediately. No account or login is required. Location permission is used on-device for nearby places, prayer times, and Qibla; no data is collected. Push notifications are opt-in. If a specific control did not respond, please share a screenshot so we can address it precisely.
